summary: Aris Mining Corp filed a Form 6-K with the SEC reporting results from its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders. The filing covers standard AGM items: election of directors, appointment of KPMG LLP as auditor, approval of amended RSU, PSU, and stock option plans, and a non-binding say-on-pay advisory vote. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or going-private transaction—is disclosed. The meeting was routine corporate governance, with no extraordinary terms or structural changes warranting a special-situations classification.
